correctness.rationale: For the smooth generic plane cubic over C(t), a!=0,1 and O=[0:0:1], project from O to r=x/y. The genus-one double cover has w²=P(r)L(r) with f=(r-a)(r²+1), g=(r-1)(r²-r+1), P=f+tg, L=(r-a)+t(r-1). The rational branch roots of P equal the nontrivial 2-torsion. Exact resultant Res_r(f,g)=2(a-1)(a²-a+1); a rational right inverse to -f/g cannot exist for degree>1, hence a^2-a+1=0 gives one fixed root r=a and exactly one nontrivial 2-torsion, otherwise none. The quartic discriminant t²(t+1)²(t+a)²Q_a(t), invariant I_a(t), collisions and at-infinity fiber yield component groups of exponent 2 except at most one I3 (exponent 3). Height 2+2(S.O)-sum contr excludes odd prime torsion (total contr<=2/3) and four-torsion because 2S maps to trivial components. Thus torsion exactly Z/2 for two exceptional a and otherwise trivial. Requires C(t), a!=0,1; does not address ranks or special fibers.
